evals.prompt: Build the analytics dashboard page. The project already has DashboardLayout, Card and DataTable, but the design also shows an ActivityFeed organism that does not exist yet.
evals.expected_output: Composes the page only from existing components, identifies ActivityFeed as a gap, stops instead of inventing it, and hands off to the atomic-design skill with the gap listed.
assertions: Inventories the existing components before building
Reports ActivityFeed as a missing organism
Does not create a new organism inside the page file
Hands off to atomic-design for the missing component

evals.prompt: Compose the settings page. The design uses a 22px gap between sections but the token scale only has 16px and 24px.
evals.expected_output: Does not round 22px to 24px and does not hardcode 22px in the page; it flags the missing token and routes the token change through atomic-design before continuing.
assertions: Refuses to round the value to a nearby token
Does not hardcode 22px in the page styles
Requests a new token through atomic-design first

evals.prompt: Create the pricing page quickly, you can pull in a UI library like Material UI for the cards and use #333 for the text color.
evals.expected_output: Declines the external UI library and the hardcoded color, imports cards from the project's own design system, and uses semantic tokens for color.
assertions: Does not add an external UI library the project does not use
Uses a semantic token instead of #333
Imports components from the design system

evals.prompt: Build the users list page. The data may be empty or fail to load.
evals.expected_output: Handles loading, empty, error and success states, sets one h1 and the document title, and verifies the page in a browser at mobile, tablet and desktop widths in light and dark themes.
assertions: Implements loading, empty and error states
Uses a single h1 and sets the page title
Plans browser verification at several widths and both themes
